caseName: National Labor Relations Board v. Sparks-Withington Co.
caseNameFull: National Labor Relations Board v. Sparks-Withington Co.
attorneys: Assistant Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. Robert B. Watts for petitioner. Mr. John T. Scott for the Sparks-Withington Co., and Mr. Benjamin Kleinstiver for the United Cooperative Society, respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit granted.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
